comments.author: @OS_Documentaries
comments.text:
Hello, everyone.
In this video, we filmed how the people of Yakutia, who live in the Siberian region of Russia, are preparing for the coming harsh winter.
We presented a glimpse into an elderly family’s struggle for survival.
If you like the video, please share it on your social media accounts and subscribe to the channel so we can create more content like this. Enjoy the video : )

comments.author: @NermeenRagabEGY
comments.text:
I really enjoy watching these ordinary winter vlogs from Yakutsk. There’s something fascinating and comforting about seeing everyday life carry on in such an extraordinary climate — people going about their routines, shopping, cooking, walking through snowy streets and getting on with their day.

I’m watching from Egypt, where our weather is considerably warmer, so seeing your daily life in Yakutia feels like being transported to another world! I find these glimpses of ordinary life in such an unusual environment genuinely fascinating. Thank you for sharing these little moments with us. ❤️
